## Summary

Add `HardwareClassification` label to `test/quantization/ao_migration/test_quantization.py`.

## Changes

- Add `hw_classification = HardwareClassification.GENERIC` to `TestAOMigrationQuantization`
- Add `HardwareClassification` to `common_utils` import

## Rationale

This test file verifies module/function import paths for the `torch/quantization` → `torch/ao/quantization` migration. All 11 test methods use `importlib` to check import equivalence — pure Python logic, no device dependency. Classified as `GENERIC` per `HardwareClassification` spec (device-agnostic, no `instantiate_device_type_tests`).

## Test

Verified: `python -m pytest test/quantization/ao_migration/test_quantization.py -v` — all tests pass.
